cases.name: 8-PSK + RS(255,223) + Diagonal Interleave

full_evidence.explanation: Burst energy verified via AUTO ingest
Estimated SNR (20.0 dB) and baud with valid 95% confidence intervals

rule_decision_path: Step 1: Check BPSK (|C20|/C21 = 0.010 < threshold 0.600). Signal is 2D complex circular constellation; proceed to FSK/QAM/PSK branch.

cases.notes: 8-PSK modulation with Reed-Solomon (255,223) block code and diagonal interleaving.

cases.name: 16-QAM + LDPC + Pseudo-random Interleave + CFO/Phase

full_evidence.explanation: Burst energy verified via AUTO ingest
Estimated SNR (22.0 dB) and baud with valid 95% confidence intervals

rule_decision_path: Step 1: Check BPSK (|C20|/C21 = 0.010 < threshold 0.600). Signal is 2D complex circular constellation; proceed to FSK/QAM/PSK branch.
Step 2: Check FSK (Constellation silhouette 0.740 >= threshold 0.400). Discrete constellation clustering detected; proceed to PSK/QAM analysis.
Step 3: Check QPSK (Normalized C40/C21^2 = -0.670 < threshold 0.450). Not QPSK; proceed to 8-PSK and QAM separation.
Step 4: Check 8-PSK (|C40|/C21^2 = 0.670 or |C42|/C21^2 = 0.670 failed 8-PSK criteria). Candidate is in QAM family; proceed to order discrimination.
Step 5: Check QAM Order (Negative C40/C21^2 = -0.670, cluster count 16 <= 24, |C42|/C21^2 = 0.670 ~ 0.68). 16-point grid geometry -> Classified as 16-QAM.

full_evidence.explanation: Consensus reached: Rule engine and ML classifier both identified 16-QAM (ML probability: 0.9333, agreement=True)
Payload CRC checksum was not executed
Signal characterised (L2); evaluated FEC scheme is unsupported (Upstream stage pending: Arpit's Encoder (LDPC codec; LDPC strictly marked unsupported))
Confidence check passed: final_confidence (0.9203) >= operational threshold (0.8000)

cases.notes: High-order 16-QAM with LDPC, pseudo-random interleaving, CFO (350 Hz) and phase offset.
